name: CreateNewTabNode
label: Create New Tab
description: Creates a new tab in the web browser and optionally navigates to a specified URL.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: WebBrowserInstance
fields.label: Web Browser Instance
fields.description: Enter or choose the variable that contains the web browser instance to work with.

fields.name: UrlToNavigateTo
fields.label: URL to Navigate To
fields.description: The URL to navigate to after creating the new tab.

fields.name: WaitForPageToLoad
fields.label: Wait for Page to Load
fields.description: If true, waits for the page to fully load before continuing.

fields.name: TimeoutForWebpageToLoad
fields.label: Timeout for Page Load
fields.description: Maximum time (in seconds) to wait for the page to load.

fields.name: IfAPopUpDialogAppears
fields.label: Handle Dialog
fields.description: Specifies what to do if a dialog appears after navigating.

selectOptions.label: Press a Button
selectOptions.description: Presses a specified button on the dialog.

fields.name: DialogButtonToPress
fields.label: Dialog Button to Press
fields.description: The button to press if a dialog appears (e.g., 'OK', 'Cancel').

fields.name: NewBrowserInstance
fields.label: New Browser Instance
fields.description: Returns the newly created browser tab/window as an IWebDriver instance.
